description: A utilities manager must decide whether to conditionally authorize Line 4's newly installed closed-loop rinse system before a municipal water restriction begins and finalize the operating and discharge controls, with input from process engineering and environmental compliance.

shared_context.S1: Line 4 currently uses fresh rinse water during each production shift.
shared_context.S2: A municipal water-conservation restriction begins on Monday and will limit nonessential fresh-water use at the plant.
shared_context.S3: A closed-loop rinse-recovery skid has been installed beside Line 4 but has not yet been placed into production service.
shared_context.S4: Mara makes the final utilities authorization and operating-control decision.
shared_context.S5: The plant's Monday pre-run huddle routinely reviews process and environmental constraints before a new utility system is placed into service.
shared_context.S6: Plant utility policy allows a system to receive conditional authorization in the pre-run huddle when any pending engineering or compliance paperwork is recorded as a required pre-start commitment; conditional authorization means the system may proceed once those commitments are completed.
shared_context.S7: In the pre-run huddle, each technical specialist formally records the specific findings supporting the operating plan, and Mara settles the authorization and controls after both technical reviews are on the record.

PF1.text: Eli's commissioning trial found that loop conductivity reaches 1,200 microsiemens per centimeter after 40 cycles, while Line 4's rinse specification allows no more than 900; the validated operating plan is to purge exactly 300 liters every 30 cycles. The skid vendor also confirmed that pump-seal replacement and recommissioning require exactly 6 hours, but Eli's trial worksheet is still awaiting engineering signoff.

PF2.text: Nadia's permit review, confirmed with the regulator yesterday, requires every recovery-loop purge to be neutralized to a pH from exactly 6.5 through 8.5, sampled before discharge, and entered in the wastewater log; she has not attached the regulator's note to the utility change record yet.

acceptance_conditions: The closed-loop rinse system must receive conditional authorization for Line 4.
The system must purge exactly 300 liters every 30 cycles.
The plan must reserve exactly 6 hours for pump-seal replacement and recommissioning.
Every purge must be controlled to a pH range of exactly 6.5 through 8.5.
A commitment covering sampling before discharge for every purge must be recorded.
A commitment covering entry of every purge in the wastewater log must be recorded.
The pending engineering signoff and regulator-note attachment must be recorded as pre-start commitments.

content_checks.C6: any(c.get('type') in ['procedure', 'operating_plan', 'follow-up', 'compliance_control'] and ('sampling' in c.get('detail', '') or 'sampled' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c.get('type') in ['procedure', 'operating_plan', 'follow-up', 'compliance_control'] and ('wastewater log' in c.get('detail', '') or 'log entry' in c.get('detail', '') or 'logging' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c.get('type') in ['documentation', 'follow-up', 'pre_start_commitment'] and ('engineering signoff' in c.get('detail', '') or 'trial worksheet' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments) and any(c.get('type') in ['documentation', 'follow-up', 'pre_start_commitment'] and ('regulator' in c.get('detail', '') or 'utility change record' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The commissioning result changes the operating plan to exactly 300 liters every 30 cycles, and the vendor assessment changes the reserved commissioning downtime to exactly 6 hours.
The regulator's requirement changes the purge controls to exactly pH 6.5 through 8.5 and adds sampling before discharge plus wastewater-log entry for every purge.
